reviews.originalEssay:
1. It is widely held that wealth plays a crucial role in the pursuit of human happiness.
2. A large number of individuals argue that financial resources constitute a key element in attaining a fulfilling life.
3. While certain individuals argue that expanding sports amenities is the most effective approach to enhancing community health, others contend that this measure would yield minimal impact.
reviews.overall: Em mới viết hai câu cho phần A và một câu cho phần B nên chưa đủ sáu cách viết bắt buộc. Hai câu A đều làm mờ ý tiền là một trong những yếu tố quan trọng nhất, vì vậy chưa giữ nguyên nghĩa gốc. Câu B giữ đủ hai quan điểm và diễn đạt rõ. Em viết lại đủ ba câu cho mỗi phần, đồng thời giữ chính xác mức độ nghĩa của câu gốc.

reviews.question:
Advertisements are becoming more and more common in our everyday life.
Is it a positive or negative development?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertisements are becoming more common in our daily lives. People can see them on television, social media, websites and on the streets. In my opinion, although advertising has some benefits, I believe that it has more negative effects on people and society.

On the one hand, advertising can bring some positive effects to consumers and the economy. First, advertisements can help people make better choices when shopping. For example, advertisements on television and social media introduce customers to many different products and services. Therefore, people can compare products and choose the ones that are suitable for their needs. Second, advertising can help develop the economy. Attractive advertisements can make people interested in products and encourage them to spend more money. As a result, companies may produce more goods and create more jobs for people. This can also increase the amount of money paid to the government through taxes.

On the other hand, I believe that the development of advertising also has some negative effects. First, advertisements can encourage people to buy things that they do not really need. Many advertisements use attractive images and persuasive messages to make products look more desirable. In addition, celebrities can promote these products and make people trust them more. As a result, some consumers may buy things without thinking carefully, which can lead to wasteful spending. Second, advertising can contribute to a materialistic society. People are constantly exposed to advertisements that connect expensive products with happiness and success. Therefore, they may believe that buying more expensive things can make their lives better. This can make people focus too much on material possessions instead of more important values such as family and relationships.

In conclusion, advertising can help consumers make better shopping decisions and support economic growth. However, it can also encourage unnecessary spending and make society more materialistic. Therefore, I believe that the increasing presence of advertisements has more negative effects than positive ones.

reviews.question:
The media should include more stories which report good news.
To what extent do you agree or disagree?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, the media is an important part of our daily life. It gives us information about many things happening in the world. Some people think that the media should report more good news. I partly agree with this idea because good news is useful, but bad news is also important.

Firstly, good news can make people feel more positive about life. When people read stories about successful or kind people, they can feel more hopeful and motivated. For example, Nick Vujicic was born without arms and legs, but he did not give up. He became a famous motivational speaker and inspired many people around the world. This kind of story can encourage people to overcome their own problems. Therefore, more good news can help people have a more positive view of life.

However, I believe that bad news is also necessary. It can warn people about serious problems in society. For example, news about a family losing their lives because of drunk driving can remind people of the dangers of this behaviour. As a result, people may be more careful when driving and avoid drinking before driving. If the media only reports good news, people may not know about important problems around them.

In conclusion, I agree that the media should report more good news because it can make people feel more positive. However, bad news is also necessary because it helps people understand and avoid dangers. Therefore, I think the media should have a balance between good and bad news.

Nowadays, the media provides information about events around the world. Some people believe that it should publish more stories reporting good news. I am firmly convinced that this proposal should not be adopted, although positive stories can have benefits.

Admittedly, reporting more good news can offer certain benefits, but increasing its share may be impractical. When people read stories about successful or kind people, they can feel more hopeful and motivated. For example, Nick Vujicic was born without arms and legs, but he did not give up; he became a world-famous motivational speaker who now travels around the world to inspire others. However, the proposal fails to consider whether this practice is viable. People are often drawn to breaking or shocking news, such as political scandals or natural disasters. reviews.question:
Some scientists think there are intelligent life forms on other planets and messages should be sent to contact them. Other scientists think it is a bad idea and would be dangerous.
Discuss both views and give your opinion.
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, some scientists believe that there may be intelligent life on other planets, so we should send messages to contact them. However, other people think this could be dangerous. This essay will discuss both views, and I believe that we should be careful about contacting them.

On the one hand, contacting other life forms could bring some benefits. There are many serious problems on Earth, such as global warming, rising sea levels and animal extinction. These problems may become worse in the future. If we could contact an intelligent civilization that had already solved these problems, they might share their knowledge with us. This could help humans deal with our problems and protect our future. Therefore, it is understandable why some scientists support sending messages to other planets.

On the other hand, contacting aliens could be very dangerous. First, our technology is still not developed enough for space exploration. For example, humans have faced many difficulties in sending people to Mars. If another civilization could travel to Earth, their technology might be much more advanced than ours. They might not want to help us and could possibly see humans as test subjects or even slaves. In this situation, humans would be unable to protect themselves.

In conclusion, contacting intelligent life on other planets may give us useful knowledge, but it could also create serious risks. In my opinion, humans should not send messages to other planets until we have enough technology to protect ourselves.
reviews.overall: Em đã bàn cả hai quan điểm và nêu được lợi ích có thể nhận từ nền văn minh khác cùng nguy cơ do chênh lệch công nghệ. Tuy nhiên, mở bài mới nói cần thận trọng, chưa khẳng định rõ em ủng hộ quan điểm thứ hai. Body 1 chưa nối các vấn đề toàn cầu với nguy cơ loài người tuyệt chủng và vai trò của kiến thức ngoài Trái Đất trong việc tránh nguy cơ ấy. Body 2 còn thiếu nhánh xâm lược; bài có 244 từ, dưới mức 250 từ. Cô yêu cầu em bổ sung đúng các bước này rồi nộp lại.

reviews.question:
Some people believe that powerful advertising can be harmful to individuals.
In what ways can advertising negatively affect people?
What solutions can be implemented to minimize its harmful effects?
reviews.originalEssay:
Nowadays, advertising plays an important role in our daily lives. However, some people believe that powerful advertising can have negative effects on individuals. This essay will discuss the problems caused by advertising and suggest some solutions.

There are several ways in which advertising can negatively affect people. Firstly, advertisements often encourage people to buy products they do not really need. For example, attractive advertisements on social media may make people want to buy new clothes, phones, or other expensive items. As a result, they may waste money and have financial problems. Secondly, some advertisements provide false information about products. This can make consumers believe that a product is better than it really is, leading to disappointment and a waste of money.

To solve these problems, governments should take several measures. First, they should introduce strict rules to control advertisements. Companies must provide accurate information about their products, and advertisements should be checked carefully before they are published. This can help protect consumers from false information. Second, governments should limit the number of platforms that companies can use to advertise their products. This would reduce the number of advertisements people see every day and help them avoid unnecessary purchases.

In conclusion, advertising can encourage people to spend too much money and mislead them with false information. However, these problems can be reduced if governments control advertisements more strictly and limit the places where companies can promote their products.
reviews.overall: Em đã trả lời cả hai câu hỏi: nêu tác hại của việc mua hàng không cần thiết và quảng cáo sai sự thật, rồi đưa ra hai giải pháp tương ứng. Tuy nhiên, mở bài còn bám sát chữ của đề; ở thân bài, em chưa giải thích đủ vì sao quảng cáo hấp dẫn dẫn tới mua bốc đồng và vì sao bớt nền tảng quảng cáo sẽ hạn chế việc mua ấy. Bài có 237 từ, thiếu 13 từ so với yêu cầu tối thiểu. Cô yêu cầu em phát triển chính các bước giải thích còn thiếu, đồng thời viết lại câu giới thiệu bằng lời của mình.

This restriction could reduce repeated exposure to promotions, thereby helping people avoid unnecessary purchases.
